issues.title: radicle_unseed prompts for consent but times out after 60s instead of 300s
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: radicle_unseed always shows a consent prompt, but the window.radicle shim gives it the 60 s timeout instead of the 300 s budget other prompting methods get. The issue names the one list that needs the method added, plus a test.

issues.title: window.swarm calls fail with "node-stopped" right after unlock
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: After unlock, Freedom restarts its node to inject the identity, and every window.swarm call fails with node-stopped until it is back. Suggests queueing page calls during a planned restart, or exposing readiness to pages.

issues.title: swarm_readFeedEntry returns different shapes for latest and indexed reads
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: Without an index the call returns the referenced content; with an index it returns the raw entry. Asks for one documented shape, with an option to resolve the reference.

issues.title: Sponsored postage: let window.swarm writes take a pre-signed stamp
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: Today every user needs their own postage batch before their first write. Asks that publishChunk, writeSingleOwnerChunk and writeFeedEntry accept an optional stamp a sponsor signed.

issues.title: Manifest field to request the ethereum-wallet identity for feeds
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: Feed owners are app-scoped per origin, so the same person is a different member in every community. Asks for a freedom-manifest.json field, with its own consent wording, that lets a site use the wallet identity for feeds (with #949 in mind).

issues.title: Encryption for pages: expose ACT or key agreement
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: Private communities need group and member-to-member keys without pages holding long-term secrets. Asks either for ACT with grantee management, or for key agreement with the page's identity key.

issues.title: Starter plan purchase reports "failed" after the xDAI is already swapped
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: The swap succeeded, then the batch step failed on a transient RPC error and the user saw "failed". Suggests retrying the batch step automatically and saying the funds are safe.

issues.title: Progress bar for uploads in freedom://publish
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: Uploads in freedom://publish jump from 0% to 100% with no progress in between. This worked with Bee and stopped after the switch to Ant.

issues.title: Feedback: "Publish Setup" for Swarm
issues.author: chrishobcroft
issues.summary: Feedback on the publish setup flow. A maintainer status pass lists three points still open: link fund.ethswarm.org, hint how little xDAI is needed, and allow manual batch configuration.

issues.title: Small docs and dev-experience notes from automating Freedom
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: Notes from driving Freedom over CDP: an undocumented ant.apiGet allowlist, identity helpers that return objects instead of booleans, and a fixed node port that stops two profiles running at once.

issues.title: Keep the Radicle mirror (rad:z3QXuMvMmSeEX3ZgoUidZC1v5MkKE) in sync with GitHub
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: The Radicle mirror of the source was about four months (2714 commits) behind GitHub main on 2026-11-05. Suggests a CI job that pushes on every main push and tag.

issues.title: Decentralized Wiki not working on Freedom Browser
issues.author: petfold
issues.summary: A Swarm-hosted wiki loads its search form in Freedom but gets stuck there, while it works through a Bee node's local gateway. A second user reported the same.

issues.title: Confirming single-range bzz:// support as a kept contract (enables lazy SQLite & friends) + test-page offer
issues.author: petfold
issues.summary: swarmlite reads SQLite pages over HTTP Range requests. Asks the team to confirm single-range bzz:// support as a kept contract, and offers a test page.

issues.title: `window.swarm`: publish a single-owner chunk the page signed, stamped by the node
issues.author: petfold
issues.summary: Proposal for a method that lets a page publish a single-owner chunk signed with a key the page holds, stamped by the node. This lets apps keep one Swarm identity across Freedom, Bee-based browsers and other clients.

issues.title: `window.swarm`: open content shared with the user's node through ACT, with consent per publisher
issues.author: petfold
issues.summary: Proposal for a way for pages to open ACT content shared with the user's node, with consent per publisher. Today bzz:// drops the Swarm-Act headers and window.swarm has no ACT method.

issues.title: feat: full web3:// protocol support (ERC-6860 family)
issues.author: z0r0z
issues.summary: Request for full web3:// support. A maintainer has since extended it into a plan for the ERC-6860 family; Freedom currently resolves web3:// through ERC-8244 html().

issues.title: window.swarm.sendPss fails against the bundled node: the recipient key is sent without its SEC1 prefix
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: The provider accepts a 66-hex compressed key, but bee-js re-encodes it as a 64-byte key and the bundled node rejects it with HTTP 400. The issue proposes sending the compressed key as given, plus a test against a node or a recorded exchange.

issues.title: window.swarm publishFiles: nested paths reach the node with backslashes on Windows
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: On Windows, a nested file such as assets/app.js reaches the node as assets\app.js, so a nested indexDocument does not match. The issue proposes uploading through publishCollection and testing nested paths on Windows CI. Not yet run on Windows.

issues.title: Feed write at an explicit index treats a node 500 as a free index
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: The overwrite check treats a node 500 as "no entry", so a write can overwrite an existing entry. The issue proposes that only a 404 means a free index, with a retryable error for anything else.

issues.title: window.swarm: any page can make main download a whole feed entry of any size
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: swarm_readFeedEntry needs no grant and downloads the whole entry before charging the page's read budget, so a page can exhaust the browser process's memory. The issue proposes reserving against the budget from the wrapped chunk's size first, and capping the latest-entry body as it streams.

issues.title: window.swarm: feed entries have no size limit
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: swarm_writeFeedEntry checks the type of the data but not its size, so it can pass publishData's 10 MiB limit. The proposed fix is the same 10 MiB limit, refused with payload_too_large. It is a page-visible change and waits on the maintainers' OK.

issues.title: Security SW-1 (Medium): under a shared publisher identity, swarm_writeSingleOwnerChunk lets one site write another site's feed entries
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: Feeds are namespaced by origin but raw single-owner chunks are not, so when sites share a publisher identity one can compute and write the other's feed entries. The signing prompt only shows "Single Owner Chunk <hex>". The issue lists a fix.

issues.title: rad: error replies can carry the local Radicle storage path to pages
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: The rad: handler returns the add-on's own error text, which can include the local Radicle storage path and so usually the OS user name. The issue proposes fixed error texts per category on the public rad: path, with detail only in redacted logs.

issues.title: window.radicle provider replies can carry the add-on's error text, including local paths
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: Three window.radicle paths (listSeededRepos, wrapCobError and the dispatcher's catch-all) pass the add-on's error text to the page, which can include local paths. The issue proposes fixed texts per category and a test that no reply carries an absolute path.

issues.title: Security R-3 (Medium): rad: reads from any page are unbounded: no admission, timeout, size cap or cancellation
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: A page can fire unlimited rad: reads that queue behind the add-on and fill the main process's memory, and closing the tab does not stop them. The issue proposes an admission limiter, timeouts, cancellation of reads for closed pages and a response size cap.

issues.title: Security R-6 (Medium): one Radicle signing grant allows unlimited COB writes with no per-write prompt
issues.author: flotob
issues.summary: After one signing grant, a site can create issues and comments as the user's Radicle identity with no per-write prompt or rate limit. The issue proposes a prompt per write with its exact content, an opt-in per-site rule, and rate limits on automatic writes.

issues.title: Support the pubky:// protocol
issues.author: MCarlomagno
issues.summary: Asks Freedom to open pubky:// addresses the way it opens ipfs:// and bzz://, with a main-process handler that resolves the key's homeserver and serves public files under /pub/ (GET and HEAD only).
